title: Communal street or battleaxe leg lighting and landscaping
text: A communal street or battleaxe, including any adjoining setbacks, is provided with adequate lighting and is landscaped in accordance with C1.3.3.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: Content twin of Chapter 2 C3.7.10, renumbered and widened to a communal street or battleaxe leg (condition). 'Adequate' lighting and 'landscaped' need a planner; no evaluator. The cross-reference 'C1.3.3' is a drafting error for C1.2.3 (communal street landscaping and lighting).

verified.note: Wording confirmed. The page cross-references 'C1.3.3'; Chapter 3 has no C1.3.3 (element 1.3 is water management) and C1.2.3 is the communal street landscaping and lighting clause, so the reference looks like a drafting error.
